findings.title: value and group_key passed to build_occurrence_and_event_data are not the actual triggering values
findings.body: In evaluate_group_key_value, `build_occurrence_and_event_data(group_key, value, ...)` is called with `value` being the raw metric value passed into evaluate_group_key_value, but there's no validation that this is semantically correct for all condition evaluations (e.g. multiple conditions could evaluate differently, but only the final new_status is used while the raw value is reused). This isn't inherently wrong given current single-condition tests, but as more conditions are added this could misrepresent the occurrence data. No test covers multiple conditions contributing different priorities for the same group key.

findings.title: Removed duplicate group-key detection logging without equivalent safety at the dict level
findings.body: Previously process_detectors explicitly detected and logged duplicate group keys from handler.evaluate() results via a list, which was a safety check against buggy handler implementations silently dropping or merging results silently. Now that evaluate returns a dict, duplicate keys are silently overwritten by the handler without any observability (last write wins) since dict construction in evaluate() (`results[result.group_key] = result`) can't detect duplicates either. If a custom handler implementation has a bug producing duplicate group keys, this failure will be silent instead of logged, making bugs harder to detect in production.

findings.title: New abstract method breaks existing non-stateful subclasses silently only at instantiation
findings.body: Adding abc.abstractmethod build_occurrence_and_event_data to StatefulDetectorHandler is correct in intent, but since Python abstractmethod checks only happen at instantiation time, any other production StatefulDetectorHandler subclasses not updated in this PR (if any exist elsewhere) will fail only when instantiated, not at import time, risking a runtime failure instead of a type-checking failure caught earlier in CI with mypy strict settings disabled for this file.
